parsed.main_gap: Lemma 4 (lower bound) asserts the key inequality |Ξ| ≤ Σε_i + [M odd]a_M via a 'tree-component argument' with 'details omitted'; this is the entire substance of the lower-bound proof.

errors.description: The crux of the lower bound — existence of a tree component (edges ⌊M/2⌋ ≤ n < n+1 vertices), 2-colouring it, and showing the resulting signed subset sum of original pieces is bounded by the sum of pair slacks plus the unpaired part — is stated but not proved. This is not a routine step; it is the main idea of the direction and must be written out.
errors.quote: By a tree-component argument on the multigraph whose vertices are the original pieces $0,1,\dots,n$ and whose edges are the pairs $P_i$, there is a set $V_T\subseteq\{0,\dots,n\}$ and signs $s:V_T\to\{\pm1\}$ such that the signed sum $\Xi:=\sum_{j\in V_T}s(j)\,q_j$ satisfies $|\Xi|\le\sum_i\varepsilon_i+[M\text{ odd}]\,a_M$ (standard; details omitted).

parsed.notes: Correct answer c=2^n/(2^{n+1}-1). Lemma 2 (picking-phase value) and Lemma 5 (upper bound via subset-sum pigeonhole and cross-pairing cuts, with mark count ≤ n verified) are complete and correct. Lower bound reduces correctly to a signed-subset-sum inequality but its proof is omitted; numerical checks earn no credit.
